name: AI Content Automation
description: An open-source AI-powered tool that automates the creation of YouTube content by writing scripts, generating voiceovers, creating videos, and uploading them automatically for hands-free channel growth.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject or theme for which the AI will generate a video script.

inputs.name: voice_preferences
inputs.description: Settings to customize the voiceover, such as language, accent, and voice style.

inputs.name: video_parameters
inputs.description: Configuration details for video generation, including length, style, and media assets.

inputs.name: upload_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication details needed to upload videos automatically to a YouTube channel.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: Generated script text for the video based on the provided topic.

outputs.name: voiceover_audio
outputs.description: AI-generated voiceover audio file corresponding to the script.

outputs.name: video_file
outputs.description: Generated video combining script, voiceover, and visual elements.

outputs.name: upload_status
outputs.description: Indicates whether the video was successfully uploaded to YouTube.

patterns: AI-driven script generation from topic input
Text-to-speech synthesis for automated voiceover creation
Video assembly by combining audio, script, and visual media
Automated content publishing via API integration with YouTube
steps: Receive topic and user preferences as input
Generate a video script using AI text generation
Produce a voiceover audio file from the script using text-to-speech
Create a video by combining the voiceover, script visuals, and media elements
Automatically upload the generated video to a linked YouTube channel
use_cases: Automating YouTube video content creation for content creators
Rapid production of educational or marketing videos without manual effort
Hands-free scaling of YouTube channels using AI content generation
Experimenting with AI-driven multimedia content pipelines

prompt_templates.name: script_generation
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed script for a YouTube video about: {topic}

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_customization
prompt_templates.template: Generate a voiceover in {voice_language} with {voice_accent} accent for this script: {script}

prompt_templates.name: video_creation
prompt_templates.template: Create a video using the following script and voiceover audio: {script} | {voiceover_audio}

prompt_templates.name: upload_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video file {video_file} to YouTube channel with credentials {upload_credentials}
